info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Payments Payments Webhooks-v3-spec
info.description: The Payment Webhook Status API provides developers with the ability to monitor the status of payment webhook events. By utilizing this API, consumers can receive updated information on payment transactions, allowing for seamless integration with payment processing systems. Typical use cases include reconciling payment statuses, troubleshooting transaction issues, and enhancing user notifications. This endpoint serves as a reliable resource for tracking and managing webhook-related activities, ensuring that businesses maintain accurate records of payment events.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve information about the payment webhook events. Use this to check the status or details of payment notifications sent by the system.

requestBody.description: This endpoint retrieves webhook events related to payment operations. The request body must conform to the JSON schema defined for this operation. Ensure that the relevant data is provided in the required format.

200.description: Successfully retrieved data from the webhook endpoint.

ListPaymentsPaymentsWebhooksRequest.description: A JSON-encoded string representing the request body for the GET operation related to payments webhook.

status.description: Indicates whether the payment operation was successful.

ListPaymentsPaymentsWebhooksResponse_200.description: Response schema for the 200 OK response of the GET operations webhook. Contains details related to the payment processing.
